name: Houston, TX
intro: A starter list, verified on the Houston Parks and Recreation Department pickleball page at houstontx.gov as of November 26, 2026. The city lists indoor open play at several community centers, with days and times posted, and outdoor courts in neighborhood parks on a first come, first served basis. The city page lists 17 outdoor parks, each with 2 courts, and most of those courts are shared with tennis courts. This page lists the indoor open play centers plus Jaycee Park, which has dedicated outdoor courts. The city page says players must bring their own nets except at Alief and Jaycee Park. It does not publish fees or skill levels, so call the center before your first visit. New to open play? Start with the national guides linked below, including our guides to indoor drop-in and the kitchen rule, or browse all US cities.

venues.beginner_friendly_notes: The city page says players must bring their own nets at all locations except Alief and Jaycee Park. Skill levels are not stated, so call the center to ask whether newer players are common at this session.
venues.fees: Fees not published on the city pickleball page. Call the center to ask.
